name: Message Reactions
description: Emoji reactions on chat messages. People react from the message toolbar or right-click menu, and agents react with the agents.react tool, for example a 👍 on a quick instruction instead of a "Got it" reply. On a channel bot, the agent's reaction is mirrored onto the message it answered on platforms that support bot reactions.

config.description: Put an emoji reaction on a message in the current conversation, the way a person reacts in a messaging app. Omit message_id to react to the user's latest message: use it to acknowledge a quick instruction (👍), thank (🙏), laugh (😂), celebrate (🎉) or empathise (😢) without padding your reply with "Got it". React only when a person would; most messages need none, and a reaction never replaces an answer the user is waiting for. Pass an exact persisted message_id (for example from search_conversations.search) to react to an earlier message or to another agent's message. Repeating the same reaction is idempotent. Core resolves the conversation and the reacting agent; neither can be supplied here.

message_id.description: Optional. The exact persisted Core message id to react to. Omit it to react to the user's latest message. Streaming/client-generated ids and ids from another conversation are rejected; messages authored by other agents are allowed.

emoji.description: One emoji, such as 👍, 🙏, 😂, 🎉, ❤️ or 👀. Prefer common emoji: chat platforms such as Telegram only accept a fixed set.
